entities.summary: Denis Ivanovich Cyplenkov, nicknamed the Russian Hulk, is a Ukrainian-born Russian professional arm-wrestler, former strongman, and former powerlifter. Denis has four Nemiroff World Cup super heavyweight victories, multiple A1 Russian Open World Armwrestling Grand Prix championship titles and seven Zloty Tur absolute division championship titles. He is widely accepted to be one of the best arm-wrestlers and the best left arm arm-wrestler of the superheavyweight category.
